title: Word cloud
subtitle: {diaries} entries · {terms} words
modeCumulativeHint: Everything from the start up to this period
emptyTitle: Nothing to cloud in this range yet
emptyDesc: Pick another range, or write something first.
windowBarsHint: Each bar is one cloud on the timeline
windowLengthHint: Clouds sit back to back without overlapping
windowKeepLast: That range won't work, keeping the last settings
errEmptyRange: The end has to be later than the start
errTooManyWindows: Too many clouds (400 max). Pick a shorter range
rangeHint: Tap a month to start, tap another to finish
rangePickedStart: Start: {day} — now tap the month it should end
lexiconHint: Some words get split, others get glued together (「今天」 and 「天气」 becoming 「今天天气」). Add them here to count them as written.
blockedHint: Only affects the cloud; your diary text is never changed.
blockedClearMessage: All {count} words will be removed and shown again.
wordsRejected: Already added, or the list is full
hideSingleCharsHint: Single characters such as 的, 了, 去, 说 stay out of the cloud (雨 and 猫 too). Add any you want to keep to 「Words to keep」.
priorityHint: Words to hide win over words to keep, and both win over the built-in ignore list. Stored on this device only.
